## Beta — Cards register themselves (no more stale cache)

The integration now loads the two cards automatically through Home Assistant's frontend, with the integration version in the URL (`/local/chronotask/…js?v=<version>`). Every release has a new URL, so an update can no longer be hidden by the browser cache or by a CDN/reverse proxy in front of Home Assistant (e.g. Cloudflare serving an old copy).

- Works with both storage-mode and YAML-mode dashboards; your dashboard configuration is not touched.
- **No more manual Lovelace Resources.** If you added `/local/chronotask/…` under *Settings → Dashboards → ⋮ → Resources* in the past, you can remove those two entries (leaving them is harmless).
- README installation section updated accordingly.

After updating, restart Home Assistant and do a hard refresh once.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/andker87/Home-Assistant-ChronoTask/compare/v1.4.0-beta3...v1.4.0-beta4
